title: Aye Dure Darya e Najaf shere yazdaani
body:
Aye Dore Dariyaye Najaf Shere Yazdani
Benger Bahale Yosufath Ghashta Khuldani
Benger Bahale Abedasth Ghashta Zindani
Benger Bahale Khasimasth Ghashta Bejani
Aye Shere Yazdani, Shame Shabistani
Yosufe Kan Aani, Mahe Darakshani
Abbas Alamdarm Chashod Khurda Paikani
Akbare Dildarm Chashod Shuda Khurbani
<<MINI>>
Aye Shere Yazdani, Yosufe Kan Aani
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghare Sheerkharum Chashod Khurdo Paikani
In Auno Jafarim Chashod Ghashta Khurbani
<<MINI>>
Aye Shere Yazdani, Yosufe Kan Aani
